writeup: Woot has the ALPS OutdoorZ Ducks Unlimited Wetland Seat, new, in Mossy Oak Original Bottomland, for $27.99. Rogers Sporting Goods and Rogers Lures both sell the exact same seat (ALPS part 9200246, UPC 703438922462) for $69.99, so you save $42, or 60%. It has an aluminum wedge leg that adjusts from 18 to 28 inches and folds flat for the walk in. Only one was left when we checked, with a limit of three per customer.
